page.name: Med Spa — A front desk that cannot keep up
page.audience: Owner, or the practice manager who runs the front desk
page.headline: In a treatment room while the front desk is checking someone out
page.subheadline: An AI Voice Assistant that answers while the front desk is with a client, asks what a consultation enquiry needs, and keeps the follow-up moving.

disclosure.text: This page is shared by an independent iThinq AI Partner, who may be compensated if you become a customer.

sections.heading: The situation
sections.body: In a treatment room while the front desk is checking someone out

sections.heading: What it costs
sections.body: Consultation enquiries arrive while the team is with clients. Post-consultation follow-up depends on who has a spare ten minutes. The consultation is booked somewhere else by the evening.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Answers inbound calls. Takes the caller through the questions the team would ask. Hands the conversation back in a form the business can act on. Asks the same questions in the same order whoever is on shift. Keeps follow-up moving after the call. Answers calls outside opening hours, where your setup supports it — depends on how the setup is configured — confirm on the demo rather than assuming it is on. Does not replace the people who take the conversations that need a person.

sections.heading: This suits you if
items: Consultation enquiries arrive while the team is with clients
The front desk is the busiest point in the clinic
Follow-up after a consult depends on who has a spare ten minutes

sections.heading: This is not for you if
items: You have front-desk cover that picks up as enquiries arrive
You are looking for clinical advice rather than help with the enquiries around it

qa.question: If they say it sounds too technical
qa.answer: That is the usual reaction, and it is fair. From your side it is a phone call — the caller has an ordinary conversation, and nobody on your team has to learn a new system to get the message. Take a look and tell me if I am wrong.

qa.question: If they say not right now
qa.answer: Totally fine. I will send the link anyway so it is there when the timing is better. No follow-up unless you want one.
